name: reset_audio_dma_state
description: Sets the four audio channel volume and period registers to fixed values, clears the matching audio state bytes and a global, then returns.

name: advance_audio_channel_timers
description: Calls four unnamed routines, then, when an enable flag is set, decrements a counter, calls a function pointer stored in the audio state, and either resets the state or writes timing values into the channel record.

name: decrement_timer_and_dispatch
description: Returns if its flag is clear; otherwise it decrements a positive counter, calls a routine and a function pointer stored in the structure, then either clears the flag and a byte when the timer is zero or clamps a value and writes the sum of three fields to the output.

name: step_timer_and_store_pointer
description: Either installs a fallback handler when a counter is below two, or sets a flag in a channel record, decrements its counter, and on reaching zero stores a data pointer and a value into the output record.

name: set_flag_step_counter_store
description: Sets a flag bit in a channel record, decrements its counter, and on reaching zero reloads the counter's complement and stores a data pointer and word into the output record.

name: set_flag_and_accumulate_short
description: Writes a constant flag word into one structure and adds a short field from another structure into its short field, then returns.

name: step_channel_period_register
description: Decrements a channel counter and, when it expires, writes the channel's period and pointer registers and returns a masked status word; otherwise it returns a masked status word and can load a new counter value from a flag.

name: decrement_counters_and_flip_sign
description: Decrements two counters in a channel structure and accumulates other fields into a running total; it returns early while the first counter is still nonzero, and when the second counter expires it reloads it from another structure and flips the sign of a field.

name: mask_interrupt_status_bits
description: Masks a global value with a fixed bit pattern, shifts it right seven bits and stores the result, then returns the input word unchanged; the listed facts also name the DMA and interrupt enable and request registers as touched.

name: tick_audio_state_reset
description: Decrements a countdown when enabled and reloads it; when the second counter goes negative it clears the audio volume and period registers and the associated state bytes.

name: initialise_four_channel_state
description: Initialises the same four channel state records as its sibling routine, setting a data pointer per channel, clearing state bytes, setting flags and writing sentinel values; it also calls five unnamed routines and reads the fire button and disk status register.

name: advance_sound_script_channel
description: Processes one channel's sound script by reading command bytes for notes, waits, loops, volume changes and the end code, updating the channel's period and volume words, and writing them to the audio channel registers when the channel is active; it calls five unnamed routines.

name: dispatch_channel_command_byte
description: Interprets one command byte of a channel script: for each recognised code it sets a sample pointer, stores a volume or envelope value, or updates a channel field, and it returns without action for the end code.

name: step_channel_envelope_value
description: Returns a level value from a channel record: a non-negative state byte is returned directly, otherwise a step counter counts down, reloads a pointer and value from a table when it expires, and the doubled level is returned.

name: step_channel_envelope_level
description: Counts down a channel's step counter, reloads its table pointer and value when it expires, and returns twice the stored level.

name: read_channel_envelope_entry
description: Reads an entry from a channel's envelope table, sets the step counters and table pointer from it, and returns twice the stored level.

name: clear_flag_and_advance_pointer
description: Clears bit six of a channel flag byte, stores two bytes derived from a register value and the byte at a pointer, advances the stored pointer by one, and returns twice a signed level byte.

name: update_timer_counter
description: When a timer flag is set, updates a slope value from a 16-bit delta when its sign bit is set and clears that bit; then either accumulates the value into an output short and decrements a byte counter, or decrements a second counter while it is nonzero.

name: trigger_channel_note
description: When two channel counters are active and the first reaches zero, it advances the channel's note data, computes a clamped volume and a period, and writes the audio channel's address, length and period registers, then makes one unnamed call.

name: poll_status_with_timeout
description: Polls status bits in nested counted loops and returns an all-ones word when a status condition is met, or zero when the outer count expires.

name: service_interrupt_request_bits
description: Keeps the low status bits of a global, calls one unnamed routine when bit four is set, sets a status byte and returns; the listed facts name the interrupt request registers as touched.

name: advance_pseudorandom_state
description: Advances a 32-bit pseudo-random state by adding a counter, exclusive-ORing it into a stored longword, and shifting bits through a carry-style feedback, then returns the resulting top word.

name: dispatch_loader_result_code
description: Calls six unnamed routines, then branches on a 16-bit result code: for three codes it writes patch values into globals or clears a block of memory, and for others it sets a flag; the decompiler reports bad instruction data at the end.

name: write_jump_patch_words
description: Calls one unnamed routine through a table entry, then writes a jump instruction to another routine and a few constant words into a global.

name: write_patch_for_highs_entry
description: Calls eight unnamed routines and writes a sequence of jump, branch and no-op instruction words into a global; when a result equals a fixed code it calls another routine. The entry references the text highs.

name: xor_decrypt_key_block
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then exclusive-ORs a block of bytes at a fixed location with a descending key byte, and returns a fixed status value.

name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only its fifteen-instruction length, its address-taken reference and one outgoing call are known; no library or register use is recorded.

name: write_jump_patch_words
description: Writes a constant word and a jump instruction to a fixed routine into a global, with the decompiler reporting bad instruction data at the end.

name: write_single_jump_patch
description: Writes a jump instruction to another routine into a global and then ends in a bad instruction data path that the decompiler reports.

name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only its fifteen-instruction length, two callers and two outgoing calls are known; no library or register use is recorded.

name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only its fifteen-instruction length, one caller and one outgoing call are known; no library or register use is recorded.

name: write_jump_patch_words
description: Writes a constant word and a jump instruction to a fixed routine into a global; the decompiler reports bad instruction data at the end.

name: write_jump_patch_words
description: Writes a jump instruction to another routine into a global, then ends in a bad instruction data path that the decompiler reports.

name: stub_undecompiled_routine
description: The decompiler timed out, so only its ten-instruction length, its address-taken reference and one outgoing call are known; no library or register use is recorded.

name: write_patch_for_highs_entry
description: Writes jump and constant words into a global, makes eight unnamed calls, calls one routine when a status result equals a fixed code, and references the text highs.

name: xor_decrypt_key_block
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then exclusive-ORs a block of bytes with a descending key from the input value and returns a fixed status value; the entry references the text highs.

name: xor_decrypt_counted_block
description: Exclusive-ORs a block of bytes pointed to by an address register with a descending key derived from the D0 input, one byte per step, and returns D0; six unnamed routines call it.

name: xor_decrypt_key_block
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then exclusive-ORs a block of bytes at a fixed location with a descending key byte and returns a fixed status value.

name: return_low_or_input_registers
description: Calls a routine through a function table entry and returns its low longword when the high longword is zero; otherwise it returns the D0 and D1 input registers unchanged.

name: configure_interrupts_and_copper
description: The decompiler timed out, so this is described from the facts: it writes the copper pointer, the DMA and interrupt enable registers and one custom register, makes five unnamed calls, and references the text highs.

name: xor_decrypt_key_block
description: Calls one unnamed routine, then exclusive-ORs a block of bytes at a fixed location with a descending key byte and returns a fixed status value.

name: depack_selected_table_block
description: Looks up an index in a table of words to choose a packed block, decodes it backward with bit-reader refills and literal or back-reference copies into a fixed output area, and writes a marker byte when a flag equals sixteen.

name: depack_backward_continuation
description: Continues a backward depacking pass by decoding a bit-counted length and writing literal bytes toward the start limit.

name: depack_backward_copy_entry
description: Continues a backward depacking pass by copying a run of earlier bytes or decoding literal bits, then writes a marker byte when a flag equals sixteen and returns.

name: depack_backward_run_entry
description: Enters a backward depacking loop that copies a run of earlier bytes, then decodes literals with a bit reader until the write limit is reached.

name: copy_backward_run_bytes
description: Copies a backward run of bytes, repeating a run byte for each encoded count until the write limit is reached, and writes a marker byte when a flag equals sixteen.

name: skip_marker_bytes_backward
description: Copies bytes backward from the input pointer while skipping bytes equal to a marker value, repeating a run byte for each count, and writes a marker byte when a flag equals sixteen.

name: write_marker_if_flag_set
description: Writes a fixed marker byte to a fixed offset when a flag byte equals sixteen, then returns.

name: depack_bitstream_main_loop
description: Runs the main bit-stream unpacking loop: reads control bits, copies back-references of a length decoded from a bit field, or writes literal bytes, moving a write pointer backward until it reaches the start limit.

name: store_pair_of_globals
description: Stores the value three into one global and zero into another, then returns.

name: set_two_global_constants
description: Stores the value nine into one global and one hundred thousand into another, then returns.

name: call_table_entry_with_buffer
description: Calls a routine through a function table entry with a pointer computed from the D1 input and the address register, then returns zero.
